subject: Org handoff and Q4 review packets — goals sync & manager notes
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Org handoff + Q4 review packets — initial ask

Hi team,

As discussed in leadership sync, we need to consolidate the Q4 review packets and manager notes for the upcoming calibration. Two asks:

1) Stephanie/Neha — can HR publish the standardized "Q4_review_packet_template.docx" to the shared Drive folder by EOD Tuesday? We want a consistent format for goal progress, calibration notes, and any confidential flags.

2) Managers (Laura, Markus) — please slot a 30-min manager handoff with your skip-levels and upload a completed packet 48 hours before your calibration meeting. Use the confidential manager_notes_confidential.xlsx for sensitive items and mark any items requiring HR follow-up.

I'm looping Vivek for any leadership-level exceptions (compensation or org moves).

Thanks — Camila

Camila Reyes
VP, People Operations | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: Q4_review_packet_template.docx (template)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-29T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Org handoff + Q4 review packets — initial ask

Camila — thanks.

I’ll post the template to the Drive folder (link below) by Tue EOD. I’ll also include a brief guidance doc for "when to escalate to HR" and a redaction checklist for sensitive feedback.

Two clarifying q’s:
- Do you want the manager notes spreadsheet pre-populated with last-cycle goals for everyone or just an empty sheet?
- For confidential flags, do we want a separate secure queue (Doc with restricted access) or rely on the existing encrypted sheet?

I’ll wait for direction and will begin scheduling a short office hours slot for managers to ask HR questions next week.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen | Head of People Operations, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: manager_notes_confidential.xlsx (schema)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-30T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Org handoff + Q4 review packets — initial ask

Stephanie — populate with last-cycle goals where available (helps context), but allow managers to clear or annotate items. For confidential items, please create a restricted Drive subfolder (HR + leadership access) rather than the shared sheet.

Neha — can you coordinate retention labels for the confidential folder so we have auditability?

Markus/Laura — start filling out the template for your directs; flag any potential org-move candidates in column G and mark "HR review" in column H.

I’ll send a brief note to the exec team with the timeline once the template and retention are confirmed.

Camila

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 09:15 AM laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Thanks Camila — will schedule slots and aim to have packets in by Dec 2.
> — Laura

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-01T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Org handoff + Q4 review packets — retention/controls

Camila/Stephanie — retention and access controls are good to go. Steps taken:

- Created restricted Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q4-Handbook-Handoff (HR + Exec access only).
- Applied retention label "HR-Confidential-90d" as discussed; we can extend by request.
- Set viewer restrictions; downloads disabled unless elevated by HR.

I also filed a JIRA ticket for audit logging (JIRA: HR-2842) to ensure admin-level access is tracked.

If there are special cases (legal holds, pending offers), tag me and I’ll make exceptions.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor | Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-02T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Org handoff + Q4 review packets — manager submissions

Camila — quick status from my org:

- Most packets drafted; uploaded to the restricted folder this morning. Filenames: "ENG-Platform_Q4_packet_LB.docx" and "manager_notes_confidential_LB.xlsx".
- Two directs have ongoing interview offers; flagged both rows and set "HR review" in column H.
- One calibration note: request guidance on how to surface performance trajectory vs. role changes in the packet — should that be in the main doc or a separate confidential note?

I’m scheduling the handoff meetings for Dec 3–4 and will bring summary slides for those with change requests.

— Laura
Laura Bennett | Director, Engineering — Platform
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-03T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Org handoff + Q4 review packets — leadership guidance

Thanks, team — this looks solid. A couple of leadership decisions:

- For role changes, keep the high-level rationale in the packet but move compensation specifics and sensitive career coaching notes to the confidential manager spreadsheet (Neha/Stephanie: ensure access is limited).
- For any candidate offers in flight, pause calibration movement until offers are resolved — we don’t want conflicting signals.
- Approve the retention label HR-Confidential-90d for these artifacts.

Camila — can you send a short email to the exec list with the final timeline and callouts (I’ll add a line re: offer freezes)? If no objections, we’ll proceed to the calibration meeting next week.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Chief People Officer, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
